title: Dragon bust — as-painted record
description: Recorded while painting so the exact paints and working mixtures can be resumed later.

steps.title: Scale shadows
steps.instruction: Work Black Red into the lower half of each scale while the crimson layer remains slightly damp.
steps.targetArea: lower half of the neck scales
steps.expectedResult: A soft transition from near-black red to crimson.

steps.title: Warm transition
steps.instruction: Glaze the upward-facing scale surfaces with the recorded crimson and orange mixture.
steps.targetArea: upper half of the neck scales
steps.mixNote: 4 drops crimson, 1 drop orange, 5 drops glaze medium; add one wet brush-tip of water. The water carries no ratio, so it stays prose here instead of joining mix[] — the escape hatch working as intended, not a rule against declaring water.
steps.dryingNotes: Let each glaze lose its surface sheen before applying the next.

steps.title: Scale points
steps.instruction: Add tiny point highlights using the orange and ivory mixture.
steps.targetArea: tips of the most exposed scales
steps.mixNote: 2:1 orange to ivory; this was brighter than the original plan.
